arguments.question: For NVIDIA over the next 21 and 63 sessions, use the latest FY2027 Q2 10-Q and Q2 earnings materials to identify measurable near-term operating drivers and risks: revenue/data-center concentration or customer/geographic exposure if disclosed, demand/supply and product-transition commentary, margins, guidance, and material recent 8-K developments. Assess whether issuer evidence quantifies exposure to enterprise/cloud AI capex or financing conditions. Do not use market-price valuation or consensus. Stop once the latest 10-Q plus earnings release/most material 8-K establish what is and is not quantified; cite evidence IDs.
arguments.decision_impact: This determines whether NVIDIA-specific fundamentals or disclosed exposures provide a defensible catalyst/risk basis versus SPY and XLK at 21/63 sessions, and whether monetary policy can be linked to a measured company transmission channel.
